features.text: Breathable cotton-polyester blend upper ensures comfort and airflow during the healing process
Adaptable hook-and-loop closure system easily adjusts to accommodate changing swelling and bandages
Reinforced heel counter combined with padded collar delivers enhanced walking stability
Wider footbed design provides ample room for dressings and natural foot movement
Specialized sole construction offers reliable support for post-operative mobility

measurement: Refer to our sizing chart for proper measurements, or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for personalized fitting assistance from our medical team. Consider additional space for swelling and bandaging when selecting your size.
